document.abstract: The author proposes a new weighted function of noise power affecting television picture defined in a two-dimensional picture frequency domain, including the vertical frequency domain. This function is of universal use and applicable to television standards with any aspect ratio and differing number of scanning lines. Using the function, desired signal-to-noise ratios for various future television systems can be calculated, and satellite transmission parameters for a new high-definition television system under study at the NHK Laboratories are derived.
